concepts.gloss_en: footstool (hadom, as in 'footstool of His feet'); here expounded via demimah (stillness/silence) — not related to 'blood'

members.note: distinct lexeme 'hadom' (footstool); the mechanical he-prefix signal is a false positive — it is not דם + article. Linked to דמימה, a different concept entirely

notes: The mechanical 'he-prefix' signal is misleading: הֲדֹם is the independent word 'footstool', not the noun דם with a definite article. Kept fully separate.
